title: Clarify or Answer: Reinforcement Learning for Agentic VQA with Context Under-specification
abstract: arXiv:2601.16400v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Real-world visual question answering (VQA) may be context-dependent: an image-question pair could be under-specified, such that the correct answer depends on external information that is not observable in the image. In such cases, directly answering can lead to confident but incorrect predictions. We propose Clarify-or-Answer (CoA), an ask-or-answer agent that separately models the decision to ask or answer, and what to ask if needed. CoA first determines whether clarification is necessary; if so, it generates one or more clarification questions to iteratively enrich the context until ambiguity is resolved. To validate this framework, we introduce CONTEXTCLARIFY, a dataset of ambiguous VQA questions along with a contrast set of non-ambiguous questions. translated_title: 澄清或回答：面向上下文欠规范的智能体式视觉问答的强化学习
translated_abstract: 真实世界中的视觉问答（VQA）可能是依赖上下文的：图像-问题对可能是欠规范（under-specified）的，即正确答案取决于图像中无法观察到的外部信息。在这种情况下，直接回答可能导致自信但错误的预测。我们提出了“澄清或回答”（Clarify-or-Answer, CoA），这是一个“提问或回答”智能体，它将“是否提问或回答”的决策与“需要时问什么”分别建模。CoA 首先判断是否有必要进行澄清；如果需要，它会生成一个或多个澄清问题，以迭代方式丰富上下文，直到歧义被消除。为了验证该框架，我们引入了 CONTEXTCLARIFY 数据集，其中包含具有歧义的 VQA 问题以及一组非歧义问题的对照集。我们进一步提出了 GRPO-CR（澄清推理，Clarification Reasoning），这是一种强化学习方法，通过多种奖励信号来优化澄清问题的生成，鼓励……
tldr: 该论文提出基于强化学习的CoA智能体框架，使视觉问答模型在遇到上下文欠规范的歧义问题时先判断是否需要澄清，再通过迭代生成澄清问题来消除歧义，从而避免直接回答带来的自信但错误的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoA, a reinforcement-learning-based ask-or-answer agent that detects under-specified VQA questions and iteratively generates clarification questions to resolve ambiguity, avoiding confident yet incorrect direct answers.
